replaces: The opt-in analysis publication routes in the initial and server projection criteria.
unchanged: All constructor meanings, acceptance domains, observations, faults and execution budgets in the fixed semantic criteria.

single.boundary: Check the input and diagnostics, resolve names and construct the dialect value before publishing. Reject unresolved or unsupported statements.

batch.boundary: Apply analyze to each split statement against the same checked context. A rejection prevents publication of the batch.

inspection.boundary: Preserve the checked operation model for diagnostics and declaration extraction, including facts that depend on missing declarations.

construction: The dialect value constructors remain public. Projection lowering is an internal collaborator with no public analysis contract.
acceptance: Compare analyzer signatures and batch dispatch against the static inventory.
Run independent analyzed-SQL comparisons through Semantics::analyze.
Check rejection and successful batching through the public façade.
